changes.newText: Action Kind: The shape of the action: Single Entity, Bulk, Scope, Relation, Membership, Global, or Lookup. Records written before the server recorded it show -

changes.newText: Target: What the action acted on, shown according to its action kind. A single-entity action shows the entity, by name while it still exists. A bulk action also shows the run ID and how many rows on the current page belong to the same run. A scope, relation, or membership action shows the scopes involved, a global action shows Global, and a lookup shows the key it looked up with the entity it found, or Not found
